input.prompt:
In this repository, find every distinct server-side location that enforces memo visibility (i.e., controls who is allowed to view/read a "memo" resource). This could include things like:
- REST/GraphQL API route handlers or controllers that check visibility/permissions before returning a memo
- Middleware or authorization/policy classes that gate memo access
- Database query filters (e.g., WHERE clauses scoping visibility) used when fetching memos
- Service/model layer methods that check visibility before returning data
- GraphQL resolvers or field-level authorization for memo fields

Search the codebase thoroughly (grep for "memo", "visibility", "Memo" across the repo, look at models, controllers, services, policies, resolvers, middleware). List every distinct enforcement site you find with exact file paths and line numbers, plus a short quote/snippet of the relevant check. There should be at least three distinct sites - find all of them. Report back concisely with file:line and a one-line description of what each site does.

## Server-side memo visibility enforcement sites (usememos/memos, Go backend)

**Core reusable check**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68` — `checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo)`: central helper; archived memos visible only to creator, non-public memos require auth, private memos require `creator_id == user.id`. Called from:
  - `memo_service.go:356` (`GetMemo`)
  - `memo_service.go:367` (`GetMemo`, for parent memo of a comment)
  - `memo_service_comments.go:148` (`ListMemoComments`)

**List/query-level filtering (service layer building `store.FindMemo`)**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227` — `ListMemos`: anonymous callers get `VisibilityList = [PUBLIC]`; authenticated callers get a CEL filter `creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]` (or `VisibilityList=[PUBLIC,PROTECTED]` when listing another user's memos).
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:107-112` — `ListMemoRelations`: builds the same kind of CEL visibility filter (`visibility == "PUBLIC"` for anonymous, else `creator_id == %d || visibility in [...]`) passed to `store.FindMemoRelation.MemoFilter`.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:156-159+` — `ListMemoComments`: same CEL filter pattern for listing comments.

**Explicit per-operation visibility checks (duplicated logic, not via the shared helper)**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29-40` — `ListMemoReactions`: private memo requires creator/superuser; non-public requires auth.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:82-85` — `UpsertMemoReaction`: private memo requires creator/superuser before allowing a reaction.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33-40` — `CreateMemoComment`: private memo requires creator/superuser before allowing a comment.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:43-44, 92-93, 133-134` — `CreateMemoShare`/`ListMemoShares`/`DeleteMemoShare`: require `creator_id == user.id || isSuperUser` to manage share links (access-control on the share feature itself, not content visibility, but gates who can create/view/revoke access).

**Database WHERE-clause enforcement (store layer, per DB backend)**
- `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:96-102` — builds `` `memo`.`visibility` IN (?,?...) `` from `find.VisibilityList`.
- `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go:89-95` — same, `memo.visibility in (...)`.
- `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go:104-110` — same, `` `memo`.`visibility` in (...) ``.
- `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:80-85` — compiles the CEL `MemoFilter` (visibility expression) into a SQL statement for the related-memo filter (mirrored in postgres/mysql `memo_relation.go`).

**Real-time delivery filtering**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-144` — `SSEClient.canReceive`: filters live SSE broadcast events by visibility — private events only delivered to the memo's creator or an admin; public/protected delivered to everyone (used by `Broadcast` at `sse_hub.go:115-132`).

**Feed-level filtering**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:88-94` (site feed) and `rss.go:138-145` (per-user feed) — RSS endpoints hard-code `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}`, so only public memos ever appear in RSS output.

**Coarse instance-level gate (related but not visibility-specific)**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/authz.go:58-67` — `Authorizer.CheckAccess`: method-level (not per-memo) gate deciding whether an anonymous caller may invoke a given RPC procedure at all (e.g. blocks anonymous `ListMemos`/`GetMemo` entirely on a private instance); this runs before any of the per-memo checks above and is shared by both Connect and gRPC-Gateway transports.

Note: this is a Go/Connect-RPC (gRPC-Gateway) backend, not GraphQL, so there are no GraphQL resolvers — the closest analog is the per-RPC-method authorization in `memo_service.go`/`reaction_service.go`/`memo_relation_service.go` plus the shared `Authorizer` interceptor.</result>
